## auth.proto

Session open, keepalive, and the full state snapshot.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md sections 1, 3, and 7.

### `Login`

Username and password login inside `Hello.auth`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | 1 | `string` |  | Account username. |
| `password` | 2 | `string` |  | Password. The server hashes it; the hash is never sent back. |

### `Register`

New account inside `Hello.auth`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `invite_code` | 1 | `string` |  | Invite code, not the invite id. |
| `username` | 2 | `string` |  | Desired unique username. |
| `password` | 3 | `string` |  | Password. The server hashes it. |

### `Hello`

First message on the control stream.

`auth` (oneof): Exactly one credential. Field names are stable JSON keys.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `protocol_version` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Must be `PROTOCOL_VERSION` (1) for this schema. |
| `client_name` | 2 | `string` |  | Short client product name. |
| `client_version` | 3 | `string` |  | Client build version. |
| `os` | 4 | `string` |  | Operating system label. |
| `session_token` | 5 | `string` | `oneof auth` | Existing session token. |
| `resume_token` | 6 | `string` | `oneof auth` | Token from a previous `Welcome`, used after a dropped connection. |
| `login` | 7 | [`Login`](#login) | `oneof auth` | Password login. |
| `register` | 8 | [`Register`](#register) | `oneof auth` | Invite registration. |
| `bot_token` | 9 | `string` | `oneof auth` | Bot token from `CreateBot` or `ResetBotToken`. Authenticates the bot account; never a user session. `Welcome.resume_token` echoes it. |

### `Ping`

Client keepalive. Sent about every 15 seconds while idle.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sent_at` | 1 | `int64` |  | Client clock, Unix milliseconds, echoed by `Pong`. |

### `Pong`

Server reply to `Ping`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sent_at` | 1 | `int64` |  | `Ping.sent_at`, unchanged. |
| `server_time` | 2 | `int64` |  | Server clock, Unix milliseconds. |

### `Snapshot`

Full state pushed on a successful `Hello`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channels` | 1 | [`Channel`](#channel) | `repeated` | Channel tree. `parent_id` links children to categories. |
| `roles` | 2 | [`Role`](#role) | `repeated` | Every role, including @everyone. |
| `members` | 3 | [`Member`](#member) | `repeated` | Members with presence. |
| `voice_states` | 4 | [`VoiceState`](#voicestate) | `repeated` | Current voice sessions. |
| `tracks` | 5 | [`Track`](#track) | `repeated` | Audio and video tracks used to demux datagrams. |
| `read_states` | 6 | [`ReadState`](#readstate) | `repeated` | Read cursors for the connecting user. |
| `direct_messages` | 7 | [`Channel`](#channel) | `repeated` | DM and group-DM channels this user belongs to, most recently active first. Only the newest page when `direct_messages_next` is set. |
| `direct_messages_next` | 8 | `bytes` | `optional` | Present when `direct_messages` was cut short. Pass it as `ListDms.cursor` to load older conversations. Read cursors for those come with each `DmPage`, not in `read_states`. |

### `ListDms`

Load older DMs than a `Welcome` carried, most recently active first.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | 1 | `bytes` | `optional` | `Snapshot.direct_messages_next` or `DmPage.next`. Opaque. Absent starts from the most recently active conversation. |
| `limit` | 2 | `uint32` |  | Page size, at most 100. Zero means 100. |

### `DmPage`

One page of `ListDms`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channels` | 1 | [`Channel`](#channel) | `repeated` | Conversations, most recently active first. |
| `read_states` | 2 | [`ReadState`](#readstate) | `repeated` | The caller's read cursors for these conversations. |
| `next` | 3 | `bytes` | `optional` | Pass as `ListDms.cursor` for the next page. Absent on the last page. |

### `Welcome`

Successful `Hello` response. Not an `Ack`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | 1 | [`User`](#user) |  | The authenticated user. |
| `server_info` | 2 | [`ServerInfo`](#serverinfo) |  | Server name, version, and features. |
| `resume_token` | 3 | `string` |  | Present this on the next `Hello` after a disconnect. |
| `snapshot` | 4 | [`Snapshot`](#snapshot) |  | Full channel tree, roles, members, voice, tracks, reads, and DMs. |
| `conn_id` | 5 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte id of this connection: the `conn_id` on its own voice states and tracks. A resume that restores a leased voice seat keeps the old id. Empty from servers that predate it. |

### `UpdateProfile`

Change the connecting user's display name or avatar.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | 1 | `string` |  | New display name. Empty leaves the stored name to server policy. |
| `avatar_attachment_id` | 2 | `bytes` | `optional` | 16-byte attachment id. Absent leaves the avatar unchanged. |

### `Logout`

End the session that authenticated this connection. The token stops
working for QUIC and HTTPS at once. The `Ack` is the last frame on this
connection; the server then closes it with code 6 (signed out). Other
connections that used the same token get `SessionRevoked` and are closed.

No fields.

### `ListSessions`

List the caller's own sessions. Answered with `Ack.sessions`.

No fields.

### `RevokeSession`

End one of the caller's own sessions. Revoking the current one is a
`Logout`. Another account's session id is `NOT_FOUND`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte session id from `ListSessions`. |

### `SessionInfo`

One login session. Tokens and token hashes are never sent.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte session id. |
| `device_name` | 2 | `string` |  | `Hello.client_name` at login, at most 64 characters. |
| `created_at` | 3 | `int64` |  | Login time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `last_seen_at` | 4 | `int64` |  | Last `Hello` or HTTPS request with this token, Unix milliseconds. |
| `expires_at` | 5 | `int64` |  | When the token stops working unless it is used again first. Never later than `created_at` plus the absolute lifetime. |
| `current` | 6 | `bool` |  | The session this connection authenticated with. |

### `SessionList`

`ListSessions` result, oldest first.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sessions` | 1 | [`SessionInfo`](#sessioninfo) | `repeated` | The caller's live sessions. |

### `SessionRevoked`

The server ended this connection's session: a logout or revoke elsewhere,
a password reset, or the operator. Sent, then the connection is closed with
code 6. The token no longer works; do not reconnect with it.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | 1 | `string` |  | Human-readable reason. Not a stable token. |

## bots.proto

Bot accounts and their tokens.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md sections 3, 6 and 7, and docs/bots.md.

A bot is a `User` with kind `USER_KIND_BOT`. It holds roles like anyone
else and authenticates with `Hello.bot_token` or the HTTPS `Bot` scheme.
It never has a password or a session token.

### `CreateBot`

Create a bot account and its first token. Requires `MANAGE_SERVER`; a bot
cannot create bots. The token is returned once, on the ack.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | 1 | `string` |  | Unique name: 3 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9, underscore, or dot. |
| `display_name` | 2 | `string` |  | Name shown in the member list. Empty uses the username. |
| `scopes` | 3 | `uint64` |  | Permission bits the token may use. The bot holds only the bits that are both here and granted by its roles. Only bits the creator holds. |

### `ResetBotToken`

Issue a new token for a bot and revoke the old one. Connections and event
streams that used the old token are closed at once. Requires
`MANAGE_SERVER` and a role above the bot's.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bot_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte user id of the bot. |
| `scopes` | 2 | `uint64` |  | Scopes of the new token. Only bits the caller holds. |

### `RevokeBotToken`

Revoke a bot's token without issuing another. Its connections and event
streams are closed at once. Requires `MANAGE_SERVER` and a role above the
bot's.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bot_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte user id of the bot. |

### `ListBots`

List every bot account. Requires `MANAGE_SERVER`. Answered with
`Ack.bots`.

No fields.

### `Bot`

A bot account. Token hashes are never sent.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | 1 | [`User`](#user) |  | The bot's account. |
| `scopes` | 2 | `uint64` |  | Scopes of the live token. Zero when there is none. |
| `active` | 3 | `bool` |  | Whether the bot has a live token. |
| `token_created_by` | 4 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte id of the member who issued the live token. Empty when there is none. |
| `token_created_at` | 5 | `int64` |  | When the live token was issued, Unix milliseconds. Zero when there is none. |
| `token` | 6 | `string` | `optional` | Plaintext token. Present only on the `CreateBot` and `ResetBotToken` acknowledgement. |

### `BotList`

`ListBots` result, ordered by user id.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bots` | 1 | [`Bot`](#bot) | `repeated` | Every bot account, with or without a live token. |

## channels.proto

Channel tree and direct messages.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.
Wire enum numbers are not the SQL integers in docs/plan/03-data-model.md.

### `ChannelKind`

Enum.

How a channel behaves.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CHANNEL_KIND_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `CHANNEL_KIND_CATEGORY` | 1 |  |
| `CHANNEL_KIND_TEXT` | 2 |  |
| `CHANNEL_KIND_VOICE` | 3 |  |
| `CHANNEL_KIND_DM` | 4 |  |
| `CHANNEL_KIND_GROUP_DM` | 5 |  |

### `VoiceProfile`

Enum.

Encoder profile for a voice channel. See docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 4.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VOICE_PROFILE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `VOICE_PROFILE_VOICE` | 1 |  |
| `VOICE_PROFILE_MUSIC` | 2 |  |
| `VOICE_PROFILE_LOW_LATENCY` | 3 |  |

### `VoiceSettings`

Voice-channel encoder settings. Ignored for text and categories.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | 1 | [`VoiceProfile`](#voiceprofile) |  | Profile. Unspecified means the server default (`voice`). |
| `bitrate` | 2 | `uint32` | `optional` | Bitrate in bits per second. Absent means the profile default. |
| `user_limit` | 3 | `uint32` | `optional` | Maximum members in the voice channel. Absent means no limit. |

### `Channel`

A channel, category, or DM.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. Empty on `CreateChannel`; the server assigns it. |
| `kind` | 2 | [`ChannelKind`](#channelkind) |  | Category, text, voice, DM, or group DM. |
| `name` | 3 | `string` |  | Display name. DMs may use an empty name. |
| `topic` | 4 | `string` | `optional` | Topic text. Absent when the channel has none. |
| `parent_id` | 5 | `bytes` | `optional` | Parent category id. Absent at the root. |
| `position` | 6 | `int32` |  | Sort key among siblings. |
| `voice` | 7 | [`VoiceSettings`](#voicesettings) |  | Voice encoder settings. Absent for non-voice channels. |
| `created_by` | 8 | `bytes` | `optional` | Creator user id. |
| `created_at` | 9 | `int64` |  | Creation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `member_ids` | 10 | `bytes` | `repeated` | DM participants. Empty for guild channels. |
| `last_message_id` | 11 | `bytes` | `optional` | Newest visible message in a DM. Absent when the conversation is empty, and absent on guild channels. |
| `effective_permissions` | 12 | `uint64` | `optional` | Permissions resolved by the server for the receiving user, including channel overrides. Absent on older servers and non-personalized records. |

### `CreateChannel`

Create a channel. The server assigns the id and emits `ChannelCreated`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | 1 | [`ChannelKind`](#channelkind) |  | Category, text, or voice. DM creation is `CreateDm`. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` |  | Display name. |
| `parent_id` | 3 | `bytes` | `optional` | Parent category. Absent places the channel at the root. |
| `position` | 4 | `int32` |  | Sort key among siblings. |
| `topic` | 5 | `string` | `optional` | Topic. Absent means no topic. |
| `voice` | 6 | [`VoiceSettings`](#voicesettings) |  | Voice settings. Absent for non-voice channels. |

### `UpdateChannel`

Patch a channel. Absent optional fields stay unchanged.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel to change. |
| `kind` | 2 | [`ChannelKind`](#channelkind) | `optional` | New kind. Absent means unchanged. |
| `name` | 3 | `string` | `optional` | New name. Absent means unchanged. |
| `parent_id` | 4 | `bytes` | `optional` | New parent. Absent means unchanged. Moving to root is `MoveChannel`. |
| `position` | 5 | `int32` | `optional` | New sort key. Absent means unchanged. |
| `topic` | 6 | `string` | `optional` | New topic. Absent means unchanged. Empty string clears the topic. |
| `voice` | 7 | [`VoiceSettings`](#voicesettings) |  | Replacement voice settings. Absent means unchanged. |

### `DeleteChannel`

Delete a channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel to delete. |

### `MoveChannel`

Reparent or reorder a channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel to move. |
| `parent_id` | 2 | `bytes` | `optional` | New parent. Absent moves the channel to the root. |
| `position` | 3 | `int32` |  | New sort key among the new siblings. |

### `CreateDm`

Open a DM or a group DM.
One other user returns the existing 1:1 channel for that unordered pair.
Two to nine other users always create a new group DM.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_ids` | 1 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Other participant user ids. The sender is included by the server. |

### `LeaveDm`

Leave a group DM. The caller is removed from the conversation.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Group conversation to leave. |

### `AddDmMembers`

Add people to a group DM. Only the creator may call this.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Group conversation. |
| `user_ids` | 2 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Users to add. |

### `ChannelCreated`

A channel was created.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | 1 | [`Channel`](#channel) |  | The new channel, including its id. |

### `ChannelUpdated`

A channel was updated or moved.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | 1 | [`Channel`](#channel) |  | The channel after the change. |

### `ChannelDeleted`

A channel was deleted.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | 1 | [`Channel`](#channel) |  | The channel as it was, at least `id` set. |

## common.proto

Shared wire types for SocialSpeak protocol v1.

Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.

Ids on entity messages are raw `bytes` (16-byte ULIDs). Timestamps on
entity messages are `int64` Unix milliseconds. `Id` and `Timestamp` below
are the named forms of those two scalars.

Permission bits are uint64 values, not a nested message, so
`Role.permissions` and channel-override allow/deny stay scalar u64s
(`permissions(u64)` in the spec). Bit 0 is the least significant bit.
Positions match docs/plan/03-data-model.md and `ss_proto::validate`:

- 0 ADMINISTRATOR
- 1 MANAGE_SERVER
- 2 MANAGE_CHANNELS
- 3 MANAGE_ROLES
- 4 MANAGE_MESSAGES
- 5 KICK_MEMBERS
- 6 BAN_MEMBERS
- 7 MUTE_MEMBERS
- 8 MOVE_MEMBERS
- 9 VIEW_CHANNEL
- 10 SEND_MESSAGES
- 11 ATTACH_FILES
- 12 MENTION_EVERYONE
- 13 CONNECT
- 14 SPEAK
- 15 STREAM
- 16 CREATE_INVITES
- 17 VIEW_AUDIT_LOG
- 18 CHANGE_NICKNAME

### `Id`

A 16-byte ULID.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Exactly 16 bytes. Validate with `ss_proto::validate_id`. |

### `Timestamp`

Unix time in milliseconds.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unix_ms` | 1 | `int64` |  | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Negative values are before the epoch. |

### `Empty`

Ack payload for commands that return no resource.

No fields.

### `ErrorCode`

Enum.

Failure codes for `Error.code`.

Zero is unspecified and is not a failure the server sends on purpose.
Named codes match docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ERROR_CODE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED` | 1 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_FORBIDDEN` | 2 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_NOT_FOUND` | 3 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_INVALID` | 4 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_RATE_LIMITED` | 5 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT` | 6 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_BANNED` | 7 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL` | 8 |  |
| `ERROR_CODE_PROTOCOL_VERSION` | 9 |  |

### `UserKind`

Enum.

Account kind.

Wire numbers are not the SQL integers in docs/plan/03-data-model.md.
Zero means the sender did not set a kind.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `USER_KIND_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `USER_KIND_USER` | 1 |  |
| `USER_KIND_BOT` | 2 |  |

### `User`

A user visible to clients.

Password hashes and session secrets stay off this message.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. |
| `username` | 2 | `string` |  | Unique login name. |
| `display_name` | 3 | `string` |  | Name shown in the member list and on messages. |
| `avatar_attachment_id` | 4 | `bytes` | `optional` | 16-byte attachment id, absent when the user has no avatar. |
| `kind` | 5 | [`UserKind`](#userkind) |  | User or bot. |

### `PresenceStatus`

Enum.

Coarse presence. Unspecified means the server sent no status.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PRESENCE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `PRESENCE_STATUS_OFFLINE` | 1 |  |
| `PRESENCE_STATUS_ONLINE` | 2 |  |
| `PRESENCE_STATUS_IDLE` | 3 |  |
| `PRESENCE_STATUS_DND` | 4 |  |

### `Presence`

Presence shown next to a member.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | 1 | [`PresenceStatus`](#presencestatus) |  | Online, idle, do-not-disturb, or offline. |
| `activity` | 2 | `string` |  | Free-form activity text. Empty when unset. |

### `SetPresence`

Sets the caller's presence. Offline is reserved for the last disconnect.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | 1 | [`PresenceStatus`](#presencestatus) |  | Online, idle, or do-not-disturb. Offline is rejected. |
| `activity` | 2 | `string` |  | Free-form activity. Empty clears it. At most 128 characters. |

### `Member`

A server member: profile, role ids, and presence.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | 1 | [`User`](#user) |  | Profile. Absent only in a malformed payload. |
| `roles` | 2 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Role ids (16-byte ULIDs), not full role records. |
| `presence` | 3 | [`Presence`](#presence) |  | Current presence. Absent when unknown. |

### `ServerInfo`

Public server description carried on `Welcome`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | 1 | `string` |  | Display name from server settings. |
| `version` | 2 | `string` |  | Server build version string. |
| `features` | 3 | `string` | `repeated` | Feature flags the server wants clients to know about. |

## envelope.proto

Control-stream envelopes.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.

`oneof` field names are stable: they become JSON keys in the bot API.
Field numbers must not be reused. Add new variants at the end.

`request_id` on the envelope matches the request. Server events use 0.
`Ack` and `Error` repeat that id so the payload lists every field from
the spec table. Constructors set both to the same value.

### `ClientEnvelope`

One client control message.

### `Ack`

Positive response to a client request.

`result` (oneof): Command result. Field names are stable.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Same id as the request and the envelope. |
| `empty` | 2 | [`Empty`](#empty) | `oneof result` | Command succeeded with no resource. |
| `message_id` | 3 | `bytes` | `oneof result` | `SendMessage` created this message. |
| `channel_id` | 4 | `bytes` | `oneof result` | `CreateChannel` created this channel. |
| `invite` | 5 | [`Invite`](#invite) | `oneof result` | `CreateInvite` created this invite. |
| `dm_channel` | 6 | [`Channel`](#channel) | `oneof result` | `CreateDm` returned this DM channel. |
| `role` | 7 | [`Role`](#role) | `oneof result` | `CreateRole` or `UpdateRole` returned this role. |
| `user` | 8 | [`User`](#user) | `oneof result` | `UpdateProfile` returned this user. |
| `webhook` | 9 | [`Webhook`](#webhook) | `oneof result` | `CreateWebhook` created this webhook. The token is only here. |
| `track_id` | 10 | `uint32` | `oneof result` | StartStream assigned this video/screen track. |
| `sessions` | 11 | [`SessionList`](#sessionlist) | `oneof result` | `ListSessions` returned the caller's sessions. |
| `dm_page` | 13 | [`DmPage`](#dmpage) | `oneof result` | `ListDms` returned this page. |
| `bot` | 14 | [`Bot`](#bot) | `oneof result` | `CreateBot` or `ResetBotToken` returned this bot. The token is only here. |
| `bots` | 15 | [`BotList`](#botlist) | `oneof result` | `ListBots` returned every bot account. |

### `Error`

Negative response to a client request, or a rejected `Hello`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `request_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Same id as the request and the envelope. Zero when the `Hello` itself failed before an id was meaningful; still copied from the envelope. |
| `code` | 2 | [`ErrorCode`](#errorcode) |  | Why the command failed. |
| `message` | 3 | `string` |  | Human-readable detail. Not a stable token. |
| `min_version` | 4 | `uint32` | `optional` | Lowest protocol version the server accepts. Set for `PROTOCOL_VERSION`. |
| `max_version` | 5 | `uint32` | `optional` | Highest protocol version the server accepts. Set for `PROTOCOL_VERSION`. |
| `retry_after_ms` | 6 | `uint32` | `optional` | Milliseconds until the same request can succeed. Set for `RATE_LIMITED`. |

### `MemberJoined`

A member joined the server.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `member` | 1 | [`Member`](#member) |  | The new member. |

### `MemberLeft`

A member left the server.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `member` | 1 | [`Member`](#member) |  | The member who left. |

### `MemberUpdated`

A member profile changed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `member` | 1 | [`Member`](#member) |  | The member after the change. |

### `PresenceUpdated`

Presence for one user changed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User whose presence changed. |
| `status` | 2 | [`PresenceStatus`](#presencestatus) |  | New status. |
| `activity` | 3 | `string` |  | New activity text. Empty clears it. |

## messages.proto

Text messages, typing, and read cursors.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.

### `Attachment`

A file attached to a message.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. |
| `filename` | 2 | `string` |  | Original file name. |
| `mime` | 3 | `string` |  | Media type, for example `image/png`. |
| `size` | 4 | `uint64` |  | Size in bytes. |
| `width` | 5 | `uint32` | `optional` | Pixel width. Absent for non-images. |
| `height` | 6 | `uint32` | `optional` | Pixel height. Absent for non-images. |

### `LinkPreview`

Unfurled link. Later previews arrive via `MessageUpdated`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | 1 | `string` |  | Canonical URL. |
| `title` | 2 | `string` | `optional` | Page title. Absent when the fetch has no title. |
| `description` | 3 | `string` | `optional` | Page description. |
| `image_url` | 4 | `string` | `optional` | Preview image URL. |
| `site_name` | 5 | `string` | `optional` | Site name. |

### `Message`

A text message.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. Also the history cursor. |
| `channel_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Channel the message belongs to. |
| `author` | 3 | [`User`](#user) |  | Author profile. Absent for webhook messages. |
| `content` | 4 | `string` |  | Message body. |
| `reply_to` | 5 | `bytes` | `optional` | Replied-to message id. Absent when this is not a reply. |
| `attachments` | 6 | [`Attachment`](#attachment) | `repeated` | Files on this message. |
| `mentions` | 7 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Mentioned user ids. |
| `link_previews` | 8 | [`LinkPreview`](#linkpreview) | `repeated` | Link previews. May be empty until a later `MessageUpdated`. |
| `created_at` | 9 | `int64` |  | Creation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `edited_at` | 10 | `int64` | `optional` | Last edit time. Absent when never edited. |
| `webhook_id` | 11 | `bytes` | `optional` | Webhook id when a webhook authored the message. |
| `webhook_name` | 12 | `string` | `optional` | Name shown for a webhook message. Absent when a user wrote it. |

### `CreateWebhook`

Create an incoming webhook. The token is returned once, on the ack.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Text channel the webhook posts into. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` |  | Default display name. |

### `DeleteWebhook`

Revoke an incoming webhook. Later posts with its token are rejected.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `webhook_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Webhook id. |

### `Webhook`

An incoming webhook. `token` is set only on the create acknowledgement.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. |
| `channel_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Channel the webhook posts into. |
| `name` | 3 | `string` |  | Default display name. |
| `token` | 4 | `string` | `optional` | Plaintext token. Present only in the create acknowledgement. |
| `created_by` | 5 | `bytes` |  | User who created the webhook. |
| `created_at` | 6 | `int64` |  | Creation time, Unix milliseconds. |

### `SendMessage`

Post a message. `nonce` lets the client match its own echo.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Destination channel. |
| `content` | 2 | `string` |  | Message body. |
| `reply_to` | 3 | `bytes` | `optional` | Replied-to message id. Absent when not a reply. |
| `attachment_ids` | 4 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Already-uploaded attachment ids. |
| `nonce` | 5 | `string` | `optional` | Client dedupe token, echoed on `MessageCreated`. |

### `EditMessage`

Replace a message body.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Message to edit. |
| `content` | 2 | `string` |  | New body. |

### `DeleteMessage`

Delete a message.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Message to delete. |

### `Typing`

Typing indicator. Clients should send at most one per 5 seconds.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel being typed in. |

### `MarkRead`

Advance the read cursor.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel being marked. |
| `message_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Last message the user has read. |

### `MessageCreated`

A message was created.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | 1 | [`Message`](#message) |  | The stored message. |
| `nonce` | 2 | `string` | `optional` | `SendMessage.nonce` when the author is this client. Otherwise absent. |

### `MessageUpdated`

A message was edited or gained link previews.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | 1 | [`Message`](#message) |  | The message after the change. |
| `nonce` | 2 | `string` | `optional` | Echoed nonce when this update is the author's own echo. |

### `MessageDeleted`

A message was deleted.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | 1 | [`Message`](#message) |  | The message as it was, at least `id` and `channel_id` set. |
| `nonce` | 2 | `string` | `optional` | Echoed nonce when this delete is the author's own echo. |

### `TypingStarted`

Someone started typing.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel. |
| `user_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | User who is typing. |

### `ReadState`

Read cursor for one user in one channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel. |
| `last_read_message_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Last message the user has read. |
| `mention_count` | 3 | `uint32` |  | Unread mentions at this cursor. |

### `ReadStateUpdated`

The connecting user's read cursor changed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel. |
| `last_read_message_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Last message read. |
| `mention_count` | 3 | `uint32` |  | Unread mentions at this cursor. |

## moderation.proto

Invites, kicks, bans, and other moderator actions.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.

### `Invite`

An invite. Admins receive create and revoke events.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. |
| `code` | 2 | `string` |  | Code the client sends in `Register.invite_code`. |
| `created_by` | 3 | `bytes` |  | User who created the invite. |
| `max_uses` | 4 | `uint32` | `optional` | Use cap. Absent means unlimited. |
| `uses` | 5 | `uint32` |  | Uses so far. |
| `expires_at` | 6 | `int64` | `optional` | Expiry, Unix milliseconds. Absent means it does not expire. |
| `created_at` | 7 | `int64` |  | Creation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `revoked_at` | 8 | `int64` | `optional` | Revocation time. Absent when still active. |

### `CreateInvite`

Create a server invite.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_uses` | 1 | `uint32` | `optional` | Use cap. Absent means unlimited. |
| `expires_at` | 2 | `int64` | `optional` | Expiry, Unix milliseconds. Absent means it does not expire. |

### `RevokeInvite`

Revoke an invite.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `invite_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Invite id. |

Disconnect a user without a ban.

|---|---|---|---|---|

### `BanUser`

Ban a user.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User to ban. |
| `reason` | 2 | `string` |  | Reason. May be empty. |
| `expires_at` | 3 | `int64` | `optional` | Ban expiry, Unix milliseconds. Absent means permanent. |

### `UnbanUser`

Lift a ban.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User to unban. |

### `MoveUser`

Move a user into another voice channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Server-mute or unmute a user in voice.

| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User to mute. |
| `muted` | 2 | `bool` |  | True mutes. False clears the server mute. |

### `InviteCreated`

An invite was created. Sent to admins.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

### `InviteRevoked`

An invite was revoked. Sent to admins.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `invite` | 1 | [`Invite`](#invite) |  | The invite after revocation. |

### `Banned`

This connection was banned. The server then closes the connection.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | 1 | `string` |  | Reason. May be empty. |
| `expires_at` | 2 | `int64` | `optional` | Ban expiry, Unix milliseconds. Absent means permanent. |

## roles.proto

Roles and per-channel permission overrides.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md section 3.
Permission bits are uint64. See the bit list in common.proto.

### `Role`

A role. `permissions` is a uint64 bitset.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | 16-byte ULID. Empty on create; the server assigns it. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` |  | Role name. |
| `color` | 3 | `uint32` | `optional` | RGB color in the low 24 bits (`0xRRGGBB`). Absent when unset. |
| `permissions` | 4 | `uint64` |  | Permission bitset. Unknown bits fail `ss_proto::validate_permissions`. |
| `position` | 5 | `int32` |  | Hierarchy position. Higher outranks lower. |
| `is_default` | 6 | `bool` |  | True for the @everyone role. |

### `CreateRole`

Create a role. The server assigns the id and emits `RoleCreated`.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | 1 | `string` |  | Role name. |
| `color` | 2 | `uint32` | `optional` | RGB color. Absent when unset. |
| `permissions` | 3 | `uint64` |  | Permission bitset. |
| `position` | 4 | `int32` |  | Hierarchy position. |

### `UpdateRole`

Patch a role. Absent optional fields stay unchanged.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Role to change. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` | `optional` | New name. Absent means unchanged. |
| `color` | 3 | `uint32` | `optional` | New color. Absent means unchanged. |
| `permissions` | 4 | `uint64` | `optional` | New permission bitset. Absent means unchanged. |
| `position` | 5 | `int32` | `optional` | New hierarchy position. Absent means unchanged. |
| `clear_color` | 6 | `bool` |  | Clear color explicitly; takes precedence over color when true. |

### `MoveRole`

Move immediately before a role in highest-first order; absent means bottom.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  |  |
| `before_role_id` | 2 | `bytes` | `optional` |  |

### `DeleteRole`

Delete a role.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Role to delete. |

### `SetUserRoles`

Replace the role set of a user.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User to change. |
| `role_ids` | 2 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Full set of role ids. Roles omitted here are removed. |

### `SetChannelOverride`

Set the allow and deny masks of one role in one channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Channel the override applies to. |
| `role_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Role the override applies to. |
| `allow` | 3 | `uint64` |  | Bits granted in this channel. |
| `deny` | 4 | `uint64` |  | Bits revoked in this channel. |

### `RoleCreated`

A role was created.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | 1 | [`Role`](#role) |  | The new role, including its id. |

### `RoleUpdated`

A role was updated.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | 1 | [`Role`](#role) |  | The role after the change. |

### `RoleDeleted`

A role was deleted.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | 1 | [`Role`](#role) |  | The role as it was, at least `id` set. |

### `MemberRolesUpdated`

A user's roles changed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User whose roles changed. |
| `role_ids` | 2 | `bytes` | `repeated` | Full role id set after the change. |

## voice.proto

Voice membership and media tracks.
Spec: docs/plan/02-protocol.md sections 3, 4, and 5.

`track_id` is a server-assigned integer for one (connection, kind), not a
ULID. The datagram header carries it as a 1 to 3 byte varint.

### `TrackKind`

Enum.

What a track carries.

| Value | Number | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TRACK_KIND_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `TRACK_KIND_AUDIO` | 1 |  |
| `TRACK_KIND_VIDEO` | 2 |  |
| `TRACK_KIND_SCREEN` | 3 |  |

### `Codec`

Codec parameters announced with a track.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | 1 | `string` |  | Codec name, for example `opus` or `avc1.64001f`. |
| `sample_rate` | 2 | `uint32` |  | Sample rate in hertz. Zero for video. |
| `channels` | 3 | `uint32` |  | Channel count. Zero for video. |
| `description` | 4 | `bytes` |  | Codec-private data such as an AVC decoder configuration. Empty for Opus. |

### `VoiceState`

One member's voice session.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User in voice. |
| `conn_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Server-assigned connection id (16-byte ULID), not the QUIC connection id. |
| `channel_id` | 3 | `bytes` | `optional` | Voice channel. Absent after the user leaves voice. |
| `self_mute` | 4 | `bool` |  | Microphone muted locally. |
| `self_deaf` | 5 | `bool` |  | Playback muted locally. |
| `server_mute` | 6 | `bool` |  | Muted by a moderator. |

### `JoinVoice`

Join a voice channel, or switch to another one.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | Voice channel to join. |
| `self_mute` | 2 | `bool` |  | Start self-muted. |
| `self_deaf` | 3 | `bool` |  | Start self-deafened. |

### `LeaveVoice`

Leave the current voice channel.

No fields.

### `SetVoiceState`

Update mute and deaf without changing channel.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `self_mute` | 1 | `bool` |  | Microphone muted locally. |
| `self_deaf` | 2 | `bool` |  | Playback muted locally. |

### `VoiceStateUpdated`

A voice session changed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | 1 | `bytes` |  | User in voice. |
| `conn_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Server-assigned connection id (16-byte ULID). |
| `channel_id` | 3 | `bytes` | `optional` | Voice channel. Absent when the user left voice. |
| `self_mute` | 4 | `bool` |  | Microphone muted locally. |
| `self_deaf` | 5 | `bool` |  | Playback muted locally. |
| `server_mute` | 6 | `bool` |  | Muted by a moderator. |

### `Track`

A track the client can demux.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Server-assigned track id. Not a ULID. |
| `user_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Publishing user. |
| `conn_id` | 3 | `bytes` |  | Publishing connection id (16-byte ULID). |
| `kind` | 4 | [`TrackKind`](#trackkind) |  | Audio, video, or screen. |
| `codec` | 5 | [`Codec`](#codec) |  | Codec parameters. |
| `channel_id` | 6 | `bytes` |  | Voice channel the track belongs to. |

### `TrackAdded`

A track started. Map `track_id` before decoding datagrams.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Server-assigned track id. Not a ULID. |
| `user_id` | 2 | `bytes` |  | Publishing user. |
| `conn_id` | 3 | `bytes` |  | Publishing connection id (16-byte ULID). |
| `kind` | 4 | [`TrackKind`](#trackkind) |  | Audio, video, or screen. |
| `codec` | 5 | [`Codec`](#codec) |  | Codec parameters. |
| `channel_id` | 6 | `bytes` |  | Voice channel. |

### `TrackRemoved`

A track ended.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Track id from `TrackAdded`. |

### `SubscribeTrack`

Subscribe to a video or screen track. Audio is auto-subscribed.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |

### `UnsubscribeTrack`

Stop receiving a video or screen track.

| Field | Number | Type | Label | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Track id from `TrackAdded`. |

Ask the publisher for a video keyframe.

| `track_id` | 1 | `uint32` |  | Video or screen track id. |

| `codec` | 2 | [`Codec`](#codec) |  |  |

No fields.
